finding.summary: The directly reachable booking payment screen still named Stripe and rendered a payment action while staging could be backed only by the memory transport.

implementedBoundary.clientPreflight: The screen first requires a consistent account-bound provider capability and does not load a payable booking or render an action otherwise.
implementedBoundary.clientFailClosedValidation: checkoutAvailable, provider=stripe and mode=test|live must agree.
implementedBoundary.unavailableUi: No provider name, no checkout action and no request for card, account or security data.
implementedBoundary.testUi: Explicit test-only wording and no-real-money statement.
implementedBoundary.liveUi: Stripe wording and live checkout action only after the server capability is valid.
implementedBoundary.serverGuard: The direct checkout route rejects non-provider-backed staging and production requests with payment_provider_unavailable.
implementedBoundary.testHarnessException: Memory checkout remains executable only when deploymentEnvironment is exactly test, preserving isolated backend integration tests without exposing a user capability.
implementedBoundary.notificationCopy: Payout notification names only the confirmed payout account and never invents a provider.

serviceBoundary.push: Firebase Cloud Messaging remains included, voluntary and default off in the next candidate.
serviceBoundary.crash: Firebase Crashlytics remains included, separate from push, voluntary and default off in the next candidate.

verification.backend: 209 passed, 1 intentional PostgreSQL skip without TEST_DATABASE_URL
